title: Red Hat Security Advisory: nginx security update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified in nginx, a widely used web and proxy server. These include code execution, denial of service, heap-based buffer overflow, heap buffer over-read, and memory disclosure issues affecting various nginx modules such as ngx_http_rewrite_module, HTTP/2 header processing, and ngx_http_slice_module. Red Hat has released security updates addressing these vulnerabilities in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.2 and related products.
